questions.question: What were the Israelites not to do with the nations of Canaan?
options: Trade goods or share their food with them
Greet them or speak with them
Collect taxes or tribute from them
Make covenants or intermarry with them
questions.answer: Make covenants or intermarry with them

questions.question: Why did God choose Israel?
options: Not their size, but he loved them and kept his oath
Because of their great wealth and their many large flocks
Because of their strength and their great skill in battle
Because they were the most numerous of all the peoples
questions.answer: Not their size, but he loved them and kept his oath

questions.question: God called Israel a holy people, treasured out of all the peoples.
God chose Israel not because they were many, for they were the fewest, but because he _____ them.
Israel was a _____ people to the LORD, his treasured possession.
